editorialLexicalPolicy.evidenceBoundary: Spanish realization options and constraints only. These entries never override source surface, morphology, syntax, discourse, or canonical corpus evidence.
editorialLexicalPolicy.instruction: Express the summoned or identified assembly according to its participants and function. Do not translate qahal automatically as iglesia because of later reception or quotation history.

spanishOptions.when: The people are summoned or gathered for a concrete event, deliberation, covenant act, judgment, worship, or hearing.
The source designates the identifiable body of people rather than only the meeting event.

avoid: using iglesia as an automatic gloss
merging qahal with edah or moed

editorialLexicalPolicyReview.title: Iglesia, asamblea y congregación
editorialLexicalPolicyReview.summary: Qahal supplies important canonical assembly background but remains a Hebrew family whose participants and function must determine the Spanish realization.
